request.description: One small group of THREE UNLIT wax candles of unequal heights, standing together on the SAME FLAT BASE LINE, for a Dungeon Matcher castle stone ledge. Whole group maximum 18 pixels wide and 19 pixels tall inside 24px transparent canvas. One tall, one medium, one short creamy ivory/off-white stub candle; small clean wax drips, short black wicks. Candles are EXTINGUISHED, absolutely NO FLAME, NO GLOW, NO LIGHT EMISSION, NO EMBER, no smoke. Muted warm ivory wax with restrained brown-gray shadow and one pale highlight. Crisp native pixel art, strong clean outline, top-left cluster shading, compact chunky forms. ONLY the isolated candle group, no stone ledge, no scenery, no icons, no gold holder. Calm dark fantasy environment prop.
